note: user_only=true means only the user can type it (recommend, never run). user_only=false means Claude can achieve it directly (Skill tool or harness tool) — do it, don't recommend.

commands.when: starting an unrelated task in an already long session
commands.benefit_en: Fresh start: the new task won't drag the old context's noise or cost
commands.benefit_zh: 新任务不背旧包袱，又快又省

commands.when: user wants to continue an earlier conversation
commands.benefit_en: Reopen a past session exactly where it left off
commands.benefit_zh: 回到旧会话现场，不用重新解释

commands.when: user wants to try an alternative without losing the main thread
commands.benefit_en: Explore a what-if in a copy; the main thread stays intact
commands.benefit_zh: 开个副本试方案，主线不受影响

commands.when: a side-directive deserves a background agent that knows the full context
commands.benefit_en: A background agent inherits this whole conversation and reports back
commands.benefit_zh: 派个懂全部上下文的分身后台干活

commands.when: context is heavy but the same task must continue; best at a phase boundary
commands.benefit_en: Free up context while choosing what the summary keeps
commands.benefit_zh: 腾出空间，还能指定保留重点

commands.when: session feels slow or expensive, or before launching heavy work
commands.benefit_en: See exactly what is eating the context window
commands.benefit_zh: 看看上下文被什么吃掉了

commands.when: a side question pops up mid-task
commands.benefit_en: Ask asides without polluting this session's context
commands.benefit_zh: 问题外话，主线零污染

commands.when: the session produced a record worth keeping or sharing
commands.benefit_en: Save the full transcript, not a lossy retelling
commands.benefit_zh: 存下完整原文，不失真

commands.when: an edit broke something or the user dislikes the result; offer BEFORE repairing
commands.benefit_en: One step back to before the damage — no manual repair (press Esc twice)
commands.benefit_zh: 一键回到改坏之前（连按两次 Esc）

commands.when: substantial design/build/refactor; Claude enters plan mode itself via EnterPlanMode
commands.benefit_en: Review the plan before any file changes; nothing edits until approved
commands.benefit_zh: 先看计划再动手，批准前不改文件

commands.when: multi-turn work with a definable finish line
commands.benefit_en: Claude keeps working unprompted until your condition is met
commands.benefit_zh: 定个完成标准，它自己干到达标

commands.when: task clearly mismatches the active model; give ONE concrete suggestion
commands.benefit_en: Match the brain to the job: depth for hard work, speed for rote work
commands.benefit_zh: 难活配强脑，小活省成本

commands.when: a hard problem deserves deeper reasoning, or rote work deserves less
commands.benefit_en: Dial reasoning depth to fit the problem
commands.benefit_zh: 难题调高思考深度

commands.when: high-stakes work where a second opinion helps; enabled once, Claude consults it
commands.benefit_en: A stronger model double-checks the work at key moments
commands.benefit_zh: 请个更强的模型当军师

commands.when: user wants quicker output on supported models
commands.benefit_en: Same model, faster output
commands.benefit_zh: 同样的模型，更快出活

commands.when: a long-running task is blocking the user
commands.benefit_en: The task keeps running while you do something else
commands.benefit_zh: 长任务后台跑，你去干别的

commands.when: user wonders about background work
commands.benefit_en: Every background task's progress in one place
commands.benefit_zh: 后台任务进度一览

commands.when: a multi-agent workflow is running
commands.benefit_en: Watch multi-agent progress live
commands.benefit_zh: 多 agent 进度直播

commands.when: recurring or timed jobs; Claude can set these up directly
commands.benefit_en: Set it once; it runs on schedule in the cloud
commands.benefit_zh: 定好时间，云端自动跑

commands.when: user asks for code review; Claude invokes the skill directly
commands.benefit_en: Catches bugs in the diff before they ship
commands.benefit_zh: 上线前帮你抓 bug

commands.when: security check requested; Claude invokes the skill directly
commands.benefit_en: A security audit of pending changes
commands.benefit_zh: 改动的安全体检

commands.when: substantive work starts in a repo with no CLAUDE.md; Claude invokes the skill
commands.benefit_en: Teach Claude the project once; every future session benefits
commands.benefit_zh: 一次记住项目，每个会话受益

commands.when: Claude Code itself misbehaves (hooks erroring, plugin not loading)
commands.benefit_en: Tells apart a broken installation from a broken project
commands.benefit_zh: 分清是工具坏了还是代码坏了

commands.when: a connector fails or auth expires; suggest BEFORE retrying workarounds
commands.benefit_en: Reconnect or re-auth a failed integration in seconds
commands.benefit_zh: 连接器断了，几秒接回

commands.when: the same safe command keeps triggering approval popups
commands.benefit_en: Stop repeated permission popups for commands you trust
commands.benefit_zh: 让放心的命令不再反复弹窗

commands.when: rate-limit warnings, or before a big batch run
commands.benefit_en: See how much plan headroom is left before committing to heavy work
commands.benefit_zh: 开干重活前看看额度余量

commands.when: a public repo starts receiving issues/PRs without the GitHub App
commands.benefit_en: @claude triages your GitHub issues and PRs for you
commands.benefit_zh: 让 @claude 替你处理 issue 和 PR

commands.when: a confirmed Claude Code product defect was just worked around
commands.benefit_en: One command files the report with diagnostics attached
commands.benefit_zh: 一键上报，自动附诊断

commands.when: user wants to see what changed before committing
commands.benefit_en: Every uncommitted change, one interactive view
commands.benefit_zh: 改了什么，一目了然

commands.when: wrapping up a substantial session
commands.benefit_en: An analysis report of how this session went
commands.benefit_zh: 这次会话的复盘报告

commands.when: user needs a quick record of what happened
commands.benefit_en: One-line summary of the session
commands.benefit_zh: 一句话总结本次会话

commands.when: user wants to learn Claude Code features hands-on
commands.benefit_en: Interactive lessons with animated demos, better than docs
commands.benefit_zh: 官方互动教学，比文档直观
